cert/scripts.mjs (5.8.4-5, homescoop#537; xzless 5.8.4-7, homescoop#1487): xzgrep, xzdiff and xzless are slicc.commands (script entries; #!/bin/sh) and run with only the package's declared dependencies installed: xzgrep beta / -c / -H and a no-match rc 1; xzdiff of equal files rc 0 with no output, of different ones rc 1 with '< beta' and '> gamma'; xzless a.txt.xz prints 'alpha\nbeta\n' through wasm-less 668.0.0-7's LESSOPEN pipe, two files back to back, an empty .xz as nothing, and xzless -F -X on a pty shows the text with no 'may be a binary file'. 5.8.4-4: 'xzgrep: command not found', rc 127; 5.8.4-6: 'xzless: command not found', rc 127 (NEGATIVE.md)

cert/deps.mjs (5.8.4-7, homescoop#1487): package.json's dependencies pin exactly (X.Y.Z-N) wasm-bash, wasm-coreutils, wasm-grep, wasm-sed, wasm-diffutils and wasm-less, which cover every tool xzgrep, xzdiff and xzless call; cert/meta.json's needs and needsInstall are exactly those pins, so the scripts are certified with only what a user's install pulls in; bash, grep, sed, diff, less, mktemp and expr are on PATH. 5.8.4-6 declares no dependencies (NEGATIVE.md)
